name: thinking-game-newlife-dialogue-function
description: PHASE_30_SERVERLESS_SEMANTIC_RUNTIME_IMPLEMENTATION_V1: minimal stateless HTTP Cloud Function that interprets one NEW LIFE free-talk turn via Vertex AI Gemini and returns a structured SemanticInterpretation. Separate from functions/dialogue/ (CASE1) per docs/DATA_BOUNDARY.md's purpose-separation rule. Holds no secret material -- authenticates to Vertex AI via the function's own Cloud Run service account (Application Default Credentials), never a hardcoded API key. Never receives the full NewLife30State, never persists anything, never logs request bodies or player free text.
